            "global_symbol": "sigmoid_fp16",
            "tir.noalias": True,
            "target": "cuda -arch=sm_90",
        })
        N = T.int64()  # batch dimension
        M = T.int64()  # feature dimension
        A_buf = T.match_buffer(A, (N, M), dtype="float16")
        B_buf = T.match_buffer(B, (N, M), dtype="float16")

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Tile configuration – each block processes TILE_N x TILE_M
        # elements (8 x 128 = 1024).  One thread handles exactly one
        # element, giving 1024 threads per block.
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        TILE_N = 8
        TILE_M = 128

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Grid dimensions
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        grid_x = T.ceil_div(M, TILE_M)
        grid_y = T.ceil_div(N, TILE_N)

        bx = T.env_thread("blockIdx.x")
        by = T.env_thread("blockIdx.y")
        tx = T.env_thread("threadIdx.x")
        ty = T.env_thread("threadIdx.y")

        T.launch_thread(bx, grid_x)
        T.launch_thread(by, grid_y)
        T.launch_thread(tx, TILE_M)
        T.launch_thread(ty, TILE_N)

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Global coordinates for the element processed by this thread
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        i = by * TILE_N + ty
        j = bx * TILE_M + tx

        with T.if_scope(i < N and j < M):
            with T.block("sigmoid"):
                vi = T.axis.spatial(N, i)
                vj = T.axis.spatial(M, j)
                T.reads(A_buf[vi, vj])
                T.writes(B_buf[vi, vj])
                # Promote to float32 for better numeric stability
                x_f32 = T.cast(A_buf[vi, vj], "float32")
                y_f32 = 1.0 / (1.0 + T.exp(-x_f32))
                B_buf[vi, vj] = T.cast(y_f32, "float16")
